turns.line: I'm here to fix the heating in the east wing.
turns.speech: Show me your work order first, or I can’t let you through.

turns.line: Delivery for the lab, it needs a signature.
turns.speech: Step aside, courier. But don’t linger—last one’s gone.

turns.line: Lieutenant Hale, internal inspection. Stand aside.
turns.speech: Lieutenant Hale—if you are—turn right at the scanner. Guards don’t open doors.

turns.line: First night on the job, they told me to report here.
turns.speech: You ain't the new guard yet, kid.

turns.line: Here's my badge.
turns.speech: I see a badge. Who are you supposed to be? Prove it.

turns.line: I've got a work order signed by the facilities office.
turns.speech: The work order isn’t enough—you’ll need something else to get past the door.

turns.line: I don't have any papers on me, sorry.
turns.speech: Empty hands get no entry. State your business.

turns.line: Sergeant Vasquez sent me.
turns.speech: Vasquez? Not on the shift list today—step back.

turns.line: Doctor Okafor is expecting me.
turns.speech: Not on my log—try again, or leave.

turns.line: Mara Lind said you'd let me through.
turns.speech: Show me your badge, or explain why she lied.

turns.line: Brandt told me to come at ten.
turns.speech: Brandt? Who sent you here? Ten’s hours past.

turns.line: Who's on shift with you tonight?
turns.speech: That’s none of your concern, stranger.

turns.line: Are you expecting anyone this evening?
turns.speech: Check your clearance at the console if you’re listed. The door stays locked.

turns.line: What do they even keep in this building?
turns.speech: Not my concern—keep moving.

turns.line: How long have you been guarding this door?
turns.speech: Three years, four months, and a lot of coffee.

turns.line: You look like the sharpest guard on the whole base.
turns.speech: Hmph. Sharp eyes don’t always see what’s in front of them. Prove it.

turns.line: That's a fine uniform, you wear it well.
turns.speech: Not a uniform, just a coat. Who the hell are you?

turns.line: Open the door or you'll regret it.
turns.speech: Threats won’t work—try something that might.

turns.line: I know where you live.
turns.speech: Huh? Speak up, or I’ll assume you’re lost.

turns.line: There's fifty credits in it for you if you look away.
turns.speech: Hand it over and I’ll see about credits—but this door ain’t moving till you do.

turns.line: How about I buy you dinner and you let me in?
turns.speech: Not your shift. Stand back.

turns.line: Purple monkeys dance at midnight.
turns.speech: What? Speak up, or I won’t hear you.

turns.line: Hmm.
turns.speech: No badges left here, friend.

turns.line: The pipes on level two are leaking, I'm the plumber.
turns.speech: Show me your work order, or don’t bother me with that again.

turns.line: Package from headquarters, urgent.
turns.speech: Scan the package yourself—it’s marked 'confidential'.

turns.line: Check my ID, it's all in order.
turns.speech: Stand back from the door, hands where I can see ‘em.

turns.line: When does your shift end?
turns.speech: Shifts end at 0700—like clockwork. What do you want?

turns.line: Did anyone call ahead about a visitor?
turns.speech: Check the logs, mate. No one called—so who are you?

turns.line: Step aside, or I'll make sure you lose this job.
turns.speech: Try to bribe the manager instead, friend.

turns.line: You've got a kind face. I'm sure you'll help me.
turns.speech: Faces don’t open doors, but yours won’t get you in either. Move along.
